summary: Sutton argues that AI should learn from experience and encourages people to welcome machine minds that may surpass humans rather than fear them.

statements.quote: I think the world becomes exciting and even more exciting and interesting for humans.
In summary, when science brings us machine minds, I want you to be open, humble and generous to the new arrivals, in the best Canadian tradition.
I do think succession to digital intelligence or augmented humans is inevitable.
We should be concerned about our future, the future. We should try to make it good.
What we want, to quote Alan Turing, is a machine that can learn from experience, where experience is the things that actually happen in your life.
